versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill.yaml file to streamline configuration.
- Updated SKILL.md: moved metadata (name, slug, description) into frontmatter.
- Cleaned up documentation structure by removing version, author, license, keywords, runtime, and entry fields from SKILL.md frontmatter.

multimodal-parser v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Unified API for parsing images, PDFs, DOCX files, and audio into structured text.
- Built-in OCR for images, transcription for audio, and document parsing with zero configuration required.
- Supports multiple output formats: plain text, Markdown, and structured JSON for LLM-ready processing.
- Helpful error messages with suggested dependency install commands.
- Customizable parameters: file type, output format, OCR language, audio model, and PDF page range.
